title: Root of the generic cubic as a power series in the discriminant
summary: An observation of J-P.~Serre implies that the generic monic cubic polynomial, unique among generic monic polynomials of degree at least two, has a root that is a power series in the discriminant; Serre asked for a formula. We give formulas that work over any field with an absolute value and in every characteristic. Over a complete non-archimedean field we identify the root intrinsically: it is the isolated root, the one farthest from the others.
